scripts.build: npm run build -w @credito/domain && npm run build -w @credito/api && npm run build -w @credito/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @credito/domain && concurrently -n domain,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @credito/domain" "npm run dev -w @credito/api" "npm run dev -w @credito/web"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:int && npm run test:e2e
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @credito/domain && npm run build -w @credito/api && npm run db:seed -w @credito/api
